Chapter 876: Chapter 16: The Perplexed Human Supreme (Please Subscribe)

Four seconds ago.

Tens of thousands of Level Eleven fighters were locked in fierce combat.

Four seconds later.

Only fewer than a hundred of the strongest Level Eleven fighters were struggling to resist.

Whish.

With a slight thought, Lin Yuan gathered a multitude of supreme weapons and scattered treasures into his inner world.

Any treasure that could withstand the crushing force of the four immense World Forces and remain intact was exceptionally precious.

Those slightly inferior were crushed to smithereens, used as nourishment for cultivating the Xuanhuang Physique.

…

On the side of the Human Civilization Alliance.

Xuanyuan You and a group of Eleventh Level Perfected Evolvers were staring blankly at everything happening on the battlefield.

Originally, under the threat of the Insect Race Hive manipulating the Nightmare Realm, Xuanyuan You even considered using the back-up given to him by the Xuanyuan Supreme to counter the influence of the Nightmare Realm.

But now?

Without activating his countermeasure, the many Eleventh Level fighters from the Insect Race Alliance had dwindled to five or six barely alive Insect Race Hives; the rest were dead, with countless Insect Race Warriors reduced to ashes.

“What happened?”

Xuanyuan You’s thoughts nearly came to a halt, clearly seeing the scene before him, but instinctively, he still found it hard to believe.

Thousands of Level Eleven fighters from alien races, just like that, gone?

“It’s the Galaxy Master!”

Xuanyuan You looked towards the distant Lin Yuan.

Under the envelopment of the outer world, all the alien Level Eleven fighters were completely suppressed, whereas the Level Eleven fighters from the Human Civilization Alliance were not treated so.

But with Xuanyuan You’s strength, he immediately noticed that the surrounding space-time had already changed, and the source of the change was the distant Galaxy Master.

“Dead, they’re all dead.”

An Eleventh Level Perfected Evolver murmured to himself beside him, clearly shocked by the scene before his eyes.

When did Level Eleven fighters start dying en masse like mere ants?

This is Level Eleven!

Not cabbages by the roadside.

Even the ultimate beings would not strike against so many Level Elevens, for that would easily provoke retaliation from other supreme beings.

You slaughter my race’s Level Eleven fighters, I slaughter your race’s Level Eleven fighters.

…

“Galaxy Master!!”

Tianyu Meng, the strongest Level Eleven of the Tianyu Clan, turned around, her Angelic Crown draping heavy curtains of light, blocking the oppressive force of the four immense World Forces rolling in.

As the Tianyu Clan Suppression Weapon, the Angelic Crown’s capabilities could be deemed all-powerful, excelling in both defense and oppressive attacks.

…

“Galaxy Master? How is the Galaxy Master so strong?”

The strongest Level Eleven from the Robber Clan couldn’t believe it either. In the first second of the immense World Force’s oppression, he sensed something amiss and immediately fled towards the distance.

Yet, under the world’s suppression, he hadn’t escaped far before enduring the crushing force of the four immense World Forces.

The crushing force of the four immense World Forces, even for the strongest Level Eleven from the Robber Clan, proved hard to withstand, causing injuries to both his physical body and soul.

This was after he had activated the life-saving technique granted by the strongest beings of the Robber Clan. Without this technique, he would have likely perished long ago.

“How can there be such a powerful entity below Level Twelve?”

The strongest Level Eleven of the Robber Clan found it unbelievable. As the most likely candidate to challenge Level Twelve from the Robber Clan, he was well-aware of many secrets regarding cultivation.

He knew the limits of Level Eleven well.

To a certain extent, he was exceedingly close to the limit of Level Eleven.

But now, in front of Lin Yuan, the so-called limit of Level Eleven seemed like a joke.

…

The strongest Level Elevens from the Tianyu Clan and the Robber Clan could not comprehend Lin Yuan’s terrifying power.

But one thing was clear to all the strong: flee.

Flee far away.

Staying any longer would mean death.

The strongest Level Elevens from various peak clans were already struggling under the first wave of the immense World Force’s crushing power.

However, just at that moment.

The fifth second stealthily arrived.

The crushing of the fifth wave of immense World Force began to descend.

This wave of World Force’s crushing power reduced the remaining strongest Level Eleventh fighters by a third.

Qu Li Xiao and other strongest Level Elevens, who had no Clan Suppression Weapon to protect them, had their physical bodies and souls shattered.

“We can’t wait any longer.”

The strongest Level Eleven from the Robber Clan roared. His eyes were like two universes intertwining mysterious powers, tearing open a pitch-black spatial rift, and the next instant, fleeing far from the coverage area of the outer world.

Soon after, Tianyu Meng and other strongest Level Elevens wielding Clan Suppression Weapons did the same, activating the ultimate moves left within the weapons by the supreme beings, unleashing strikes with hundreds of thousands of battle power indexes, forcibly tearing space and escaping.

“They actually escaped from under the cover of my ‘World’ Divine Skills?”

Lin Yuan roughly locked on to the positions of those few strongest Level Elevens through Causal Sensing, instantly arriving at the edge of the battlefield, and because of causal weakening among other factors, they seemingly vanished completely.

“Was that a real Level Twelve technique?”

With his current strength, dealing with Level Elevens, even those wielding supreme weapons, was as easy as flipping a hand, but if ultimate beings of Level Twelve intervened, they were not within Lin Yuan’s ability to suppress.
